blocks.text: 把同一种 transport 的多个真实成员呈现为一个逻辑对端 `pool`。

`rpc-contract` 定义纯协议与接口，`rpc-host` 拥有会话、provider、调用结算与取消；transport plugin 获取并监管原生资源。auth、chunk、batch、probe 等 flow plugin 处理消息流。`pool` 是安装在 transport 上的 feature，负责成员选择、有限 FIFO、扩缩容和排空；timeout、retry 也是完整 feature。
English · 使用指南
下面使用 Node 24 的真实 Worker。保存为独立 ESM TypeScript 入口，或先编译为 ESM。仅父端安装 pool，子端连接实际父端。
输出 `42` 和 `2`。每次调用只选一个成员，返回该次操作的结果，不广播到三个成员。

`pool({ size })` 放在 `threadPlugin`、`processPlugin` 或 `coroutinePlugin` 的 `features` 中。来源必须能重复获取独立成员：thread/coroutine spawn，或 process spawn/connect。listen、connectToParent 在获取成员前拒绝为 `POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED`。
调用与控制都在 transport 的命名空间：`host.thread.send('pool', ...)`、`host.thread.pool`、`host.thread.members`。隐藏成员不进入该 namespace 的业务目标目录；`members` 仅提供真实原生资源的诊断和管理。一个 Host 可以容纳命名空间不同的 transport；pool 本身只聚合同一种载体。
`request/notify/stream/group` 每次只进行一次成员选择。group 的整组使用同一成员。`outcome` 查询需要安装 idempotency plugin；查询只选择一个成员，不进行全池结果搜索。

rows: 必填正整数；初次安装等待目标成员就绪
默认 256，非负整数；0 表示没有等待槽
省略则不回收；正有限毫秒，最大 2147483647
只负责 pool 空闲计时
按顺序调整目标容量，忙成员完成后安全退休
停止新接纳，等待已接纳操作，再关闭成员

blocks.text: `inFlight` 是客户端占槽数，不代表 provider 或 CPU 并发。流第一次 `next()` 才占槽，消费完毕或结束迭代后释放。缩容优先退休空闲成员。
业务与传输失败保留各自错误身份，pool 不自行重放业务。池错误 source 为 `rpc.pool`；按 code/cause 处理，参见使用指南。自定义 transport 使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`，观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。
English · 包概览 · Host 调用规则
Contract 定义纯协议与接口，Host 拥有会话、provider 和调用结算，transport 获取并监管真实原生资源。flow plugin 通过消息介入点提供 auth、chunk、batch、probe。`pool` 是 transport 的完整 feature：只拥有同载体成员调度、FIFO、扩缩容和排空；timeout/retry feature 各自拥有调用策略。
父端示例使用三个真实 Thread 成员。一个 Host 允许安装命名空间不同的 transport；本例只安装一个 `thread` namespace，pool 不混合不同载体。
相应 `worker.js` 使用独立子入口；只父端安装 pool，子端连接实际父端。
工厂是 `pool(options)`，控制入口是该安装的 `host.thread.pool` 和 `host.thread.members`，不是工厂对象上的宿主查询方法。`features` 同时接收完整 pool、timeout、retry 实例；单次调用 timeout/retry 可用完整实例或 `false` 覆盖。
业务目录只呈现 `pool`（导出的 `RPC_POOL_PEER_ID`），不会把隐藏成员公开为直接调用目标。`host.thread.send('pool', ...)` 只借出一个成员；无目标 request/notify/stream/group 也只选择一次。`members` 管理实际原生资源，不是直接调用隐藏成员的业务捷径。
group 的整组保持同一成员。只有安装 idempotency plugin 才能调用 outcome；它也选择一个成员，不在所有成员存储中搜索结果。pool 本身不提供去重、幂等保证或业务重试。
来源必须可重复获取独立成员：Thread/Coroutine spawn，Process spawn 或 connect。listen/connectToParent 在原生成员获取前拒绝；pool 不把单条父连接复制成多个成员。自定义原生部署使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`。

rows: 必填正整数，初次安装等待目标成员就绪
默认 256；非负整数；0 表示不排队
省略则禁用；正有限毫秒，不超过 2147483647
只拥有空闲回收计时，不接管原生监督或调用期限

blocks.text: 每成员同一时刻借出一个客户端槽。忙时操作进入有限 FIFO，满时拒绝为 QUEUE_FULL。`signal` 可取消等待项；开始后的取消沿原调用路径处理，不能据此断言远端没有副作用。
stats 是新的冻结快照：targetSize、memberCount、inFlight、queued、state。`queued` 仅计尚未分配成员的等待项；`inFlight` 是客户端占槽，不是远端 provider 或 CPU 并发。memberCount 包含尚未完成清理的退休成员，可能暂不等于 targetSize。
流在第一次 `next()` 时才申请槽。完成、提前 return 或 throw/取消结算后释放；应用持有未完成的流会阻止相应槽排空。结束流不关闭整个 pool。
`resize` 按调用顺序串行处理，缩容优先退休空闲成员，等待忙成员完成。扩容只获取缺失成员；失败保留 primary 并在仍开放时恢复原目标。空闲回收不改变 targetSize，之后的需求会补齐成员。
显式 `host.thread.pool.close()` 停止新接纳，等待此前接受的操作与成员获取，再尝试关闭成员；重复调用共享关闭 Promise。pool 不添加自己的排空超时。应用应结束持有的业务与流，显式等待 pool 关闭，再完成 Host 清理；`closeIdlePool` 展示没有持有业务时的顺序。
池 source 为 `rpc.pool`：INVALID_OPTIONS、POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED、POOL_CLOSED、QUEUE_FULL、CALL_ABORTED、CLOSE_FAILED。业务与原生错误保留其原 owner 的 source/code/cause；池不自动重放。

部分构造失败会清理已获取成员并保留原 primary，次级清理错误继续从错误图或报告到达。最终关闭期间的成员清理失败以 CLOSE_FAILED AggregateError 保留原 errors 和首个 cause，关闭后不重新开放。开放期间已经通过 resize 拒绝或空闲回收报告交付的错误不会保留到最终 close 再次抛出。只读观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`，不在 pool 中另装一套诊断或消息解析器。
Present several real members of one transport as a single logical peer named `pool`.

`rpc-contract` defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. `rpc-host` owns sessions, providers, call settlement, and cancellation; transport plugins acquire and supervise native resources. Flow plugins such as auth, chunk, batch, and probe process message flow. The `pool` transport feature owns member selection, bounded FIFO, resize, and drain. Timeout and retry are also complete features.
中文 · Usage guide
This uses real Node 24 Workers. Save a standalone ESM TypeScript entry, or compile it to ESM first. Only the parent installs pool; the child joins its actual parent.
It prints `42` and `2`. Each call selects one member and returns that operation's result, rather than broadcasting to three members.

Place `pool({ size })` in `features` on `threadPlugin`, `processPlugin`, or `coroutinePlugin`. The source must repeatedly acquire independent members: thread/coroutine spawn or process spawn/connect. Listener and connectToParent sources reject with `POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED` before acquisition.

Calls and controls live under the transport namespace: `host.thread.send('pool', ...)`, `host.thread.pool`, and `host.thread.members`. Private members do not enter that namespace's business target directory. `members` provides real native diagnostics and administration. One Host may contain transports with distinct namespaces; each pool combines only one carrier kind.

`request/notify/stream/group` selects one member per operation. A whole group uses the same member. `outcome` requires the idempotency plugin; it selects one member rather than searching every member's result store.

rows: Required positive integer; initial installation waits for target readiness
Default 256, nonnegative integer; 0 provides no waiting slots
Omitted disables retirement; positive finite milliseconds, maximum 2147483647
Ordered target changes; occupied members retire after completion
Seals new admission, waits for accepted operations, then closes members

blocks.text: `inFlight` measures client slots, not provider or CPU concurrency. A stream occupies a slot on its first `next()` and releases it when consumption finishes or iteration ends. Shrink prefers idle members.

Business and transport failures retain their own identity; pool does not replay work itself. Pool-owned failures use source `rpc.pool`; handle code/cause as described in the usage guide. Custom transports use `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; observation uses `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`.
中文 · Overview · Host calls

Contract defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. Host owns sessions, providers, and call settlement; transports acquire and supervise real native resources. Flow plugins provide auth, chunk, batch, and probe at message hooks. The complete `pool` transport feature owns only same-carrier member scheduling, FIFO, resize, and drain. Timeout/retry features own their respective call policies.
The parent example uses three real Thread members. A Host may install transports in distinct namespaces; this example installs only `thread`, and the pool does not mix carrier kinds.
The corresponding `worker.js` is a separate child entry. Only the parent installs pool; the child joins its actual parent.

The factory is `pool(options)`. Controls are published on that installation's `host.thread.pool` and `host.thread.members`, rather than queried from the factory object. `features` accepts complete pool, timeout, and retry instances; per-call timeout/retry accepts complete instances or `false`.

The business directory exposes only `pool` (exported as `RPC_POOL_PEER_ID`), without direct targets for private members. `host.thread.send('pool', ...)` reserves one member; untargeted request/notify/stream/group also selects once. `members` administers actual native resources, rather than providing a business shortcut to hidden members.

A whole group stays on one member. `outcome` requires the idempotency plugin and also selects one member, without searching every member's store. Pool itself adds no deduplication, idempotency guarantee, or business retry.

A source must repeatedly acquire independent members: Thread/Coroutine spawn, Process spawn or connect. Listener/connectToParent sources reject before native acquisition; pool does not clone one parent connection into several members. Custom native deployment uses `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`.

rows: Required positive integer; initial installation waits for target readiness
Omitted disables it; positive finite milliseconds, at most 2147483647
Owns idle retirement timing only, not native supervision or call deadlines

blocks.text: Each member lends one client slot at a time. Busy operations enter bounded FIFO; a full queue rejects with QUEUE_FULL. `signal` cancels a waiting entry. After start, cancellation follows the original call path and does not establish that remote effects never occurred.

Stats is a new frozen snapshot: targetSize, memberCount, inFlight, queued, state. `queued` counts waiting entries without an assigned member. `inFlight` counts client slots, not provider or CPU concurrency. memberCount includes retirees still being cleaned up, so it need not equal targetSize at every instant.

A stream acquires its slot on the first `next()`. Completion, early return, or settled throw/cancellation releases it. An application-held unfinished stream can prevent that slot from draining. Ending a stream does not close the entire pool.

`resize` serializes target changes in call order. Shrink prefers idle members and waits for occupied members to finish. Expansion acquires only missing members; failure preserves the primary and restores the old target while still open. Idle retirement leaves targetSize unchanged, and later demand refills it.

Explicit `host.thread.pool.close()` stops new admission, waits for accepted work and member acquisition, then attempts member cleanup. Repeated calls share the close Promise. Pool adds no drain timeout. Finish held work and streams, explicitly await pool closure, then finish Host cleanup; `closeIdlePool` shows this order when no work is held.

Pool-owned source is `rpc.pool`: INVALID_OPTIONS, POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, POOL_CLOSED, QUEUE_FULL, CALL_ABORTED, CLOSE_FAILED. Business/native errors retain their owner's source/code/cause; pool does not replay them automatically.

Partial construction cleans up acquired members while preserving the original primary. Secondary cleanup failures remain reachable through the error graph or reports. Member cleanup failures from the final closing phase retain original errors and the first cause in a CLOSE_FAILED AggregateError, and a closed pool does not reopen. Open-phase failures already delivered through resize rejection or idle-retirement reporting are not retained and thrown again by the final close. Use `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe` for readonly observation instead of another diagnostics or message parser inside pool.

declaredConfiguration.name: size
declaredConfiguration.description: Required positive integer target; initial creation waits for this many independent Peers.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxQueue
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum waiting FIFO length, default 256; nonnegative integer, with 0 allowing no queue.

declaredConfiguration.name: idleTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional idle retirement delay; omitted disables it. Must be finite, positive and at most 2147483647 ms, including fractional values. Target size remains unchanged after retirement; later demand refills missing members through the original public factory.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Owns idle timers only, default systemScheduler. Admitted once before Peer acquisition; timers cancel on reserve/retire/close and request optional unref. Peer restart/deadline clocks retain their source policy, and timer unref is a liveness hint rather than an earlier deadline.

blocks.text: 池 source 为 `rpc.pool`：INVALID_OPTIONS、POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED、POOL_CLOSED、QUEUE_FULL、CALL_ABORTED、CLOSE_FAILED。业务与原生错误保留其原 owner 的 source/code/cause；池不自动重放。

部分构造失败会清理已获取成员并保留原 primary，次级清理错误继续从错误图或报告到达。最终关闭期间的成员清理失败以 CLOSE_FAILED AggregateError 保留原 errors 和首个 cause，关闭后不重新开放。开放期间已经通过 resize 拒绝或空闲回收报告交付的错误不会保留到最终 close 再次抛出。只读观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`，不在 pool 中另装一套诊断或消息解析器。

rows: 必填正整数；初次安装等待目标成员就绪
默认 256，非负整数；0 表示没有等待槽
省略则不回收；正有限毫秒，最大 2147483647
只负责 pool 空闲计时
按顺序调整目标容量，忙成员完成后安全退休
停止新接纳，等待已接纳操作，再关闭成员

blocks.text: `inFlight` 是客户端占槽数，不代表 provider 或 CPU 并发。流第一次 `next()` 才占槽，消费完毕或结束迭代后释放。缩容优先退休空闲成员。
业务与传输失败保留各自错误身份，pool 不自行重放业务。池错误 source 为 `rpc.pool`；按 code/cause 处理，参见使用指南。自定义 transport 使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`，观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。

symbols.purpose: Stable pool-owned semantic codes for invalid configuration, closed admission, queue overflow, queued abort and aggregated member cleanup. Native error classes and original causes remain intact.
symbols.core:
invalidOptions: Construction or resize input is invalid; fix the option before native member acquisition.
poolClosed: A closing or closed pool rejects a new operation or resize; create a new pool for new work.
queueFull: All client slots are busy and the bounded FIFO is full; no member receives the rejected operation.
callAborted: An operation was cancelled while waiting in the FIFO; native AbortError cause retains the exact signal reason.
closeFailed: Every member close was attempted and one or more failed; AggregateError retains errors and the first original cause.
transportUnsupported: POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED rejects listen/connect-to-parent before opening a member.

closing: Rejects new operations while draining accepted work and closing all owned members.
closed: All member closes have been attempted; stats remains readable but no new calls are admitted.
